_note_headline: HEADLINE RULE, now consistent across OT-B, OT-P and NT: the TOPICAL running title (OT: 'Creation.' 'Iacob.' 'Ceremonies.' 'Festiual daies.') and the NT chapter running-head 'CHA. n.' both sit at the GUTTER side; the PAGE NUMBER sits at the FORE-EDGE. The book-name RH is centred. So a three-part head is [gutter: topical/CR] [centre: RH] [fore-edge: PN] on every leaf so far.
